table.name: course
table.purpose: Lookup table of courses (subjects) offered, each with a start date; referenced by course_arrange for scheduling/assignments. Likely a school timetable dataset (courses, teachers, arrangements).

Course.name: course_name
Course.description: Name of the course/subject (e.g. Math, History, French, Bible). One row per course.

Course_ID.name: course_id
Course_ID.description: Primary key identifying each course; referenced by course_arrange.Course_ID.

Staring_Date.name: starting_date
Staring_Date.description: Start date of the course, stored as text in 'D Month' format (e.g. '6 May'); year omitted. Column name is a misspelling of 'Starting_Date'.

table.name: course_arrange
table.purpose: Junction/assignment table linking a course, a grade level, and a teacher: each row records that a given course is taught by a given teacher to a given grade (class level).

Course_ID.name: Course_ID
Course_ID.description: Identifier of the course being arranged; references course.Course_ID (e.g. 2 = Math, 4 = History, 10 = Music).

Grade.name: Grade
Grade.description: Grade level (school year/class level, integer 1-7) for which the course is arranged; the table's purpose of linking course, teacher and grade supports this reading, though it could alternatively be a class/group number.

Teacher_ID.name: Teacher_ID
Teacher_ID.description: Identifier of the teacher assigned to the course; references teacher.Teacher_ID.

table.name: teacher
table.purpose: One row per teacher, storing their name, age, and hometown. Referenced by course_arrange, which assigns teachers to course offerings (with course).

Age.name: age
Age.description: Teacher's age in years (26-45, stored as text).

Hometown.name: hometown
Hometown.description: Teacher's hometown, given as an administrative area name (e.g. 'Blackrod Urban District', 'Bolton County Borough').

Teacher_ID.name: teacher_id
Teacher_ID.description: Primary key identifying a teacher; referenced by course_arrange.Teacher_ID to assign teachers to course arrangements.
